paragraphResults.brief_reason: The paragraph states that all rights and obligations continue for five years after termination, which directly contradicts Section 15.7, which says all rights and obligations terminate except those expressly stated to survive.

evidence.snippet_a: all rights granted and obligations undertaken by the Parties hereunder shall continue in full force and effect for a period of five (5) years following any termination or expiration of this Agreement, regardless of any provision stated to survive.
evidence.snippet_b: all rights granted and obligations undertaken by the Parties hereunder shall terminate immediately upon the termination or expiration of this Agreement, subject to Section 15.4 above and except for the following which shall survive according to their terms: Section 2.2 (Permitted Use); Section 2.7 (Subcontracting by Bellicum); Article 10 (Intellectual Property); Article 11 (Warranty); Article 12 (Limitation of Liability); Article 13 (Indemnification; Insurance); Article 14 (Confidentiality and Non-disclosure); Section 15.7 (Post-termination); Section 15.7 (Survival); Article 16 (Notices); Article 17 (Assignment); Article 19 (Dispute Resolution and Applicable Law); and Article 20 (Miscellaneous); and any and all rights and obligations of the Parties thereunder, as well as any other provision hereunder which by its nature is intended to survive expiration or termination of this Agreement.
